note: Weekly target = October monthly GA4 target × 7/30, because the week sits wholly inside October: 5 to 11 October are all October days, so there is no straddle to blend this time. That gives a weekly target of 1,036. Hong Kong booked 951 GA4 bookings, 8.2 percent behind, up 4.2 percent week on week and down 1.9 percent year on year. Two of six venues beat the weekly target. Shiro (+13.6 percent) and Cantina (+11.9 percent) led it, and The Chinese Library landed level with target at −0.9 percent. The three behind are Aqua HK (−18.3 percent), Hutong HK (−15.9 percent) and Dim Sum Library (−9.7 percent). Two things explain the week. First, the October target step up: the monthly target for the portfolio rose from 3,853 in September to 4,439 in October, so the weekly bar moved from 977 to 1,036 while bookings rose by only 38. Second, Aqua HK and Hutong HK both recovered in absolute terms, Aqua to 206 from 178 and Hutong to 243 from 213, and both did it on fewer users, so conversion improved at each: Aqua 5.6 percent from 4.5 percent and Hutong 7.3 percent from 6.1 percent. They are still the two largest shortfalls against the higher October bar. Dim Sum Library had its best week of the eight at 168, up 23.5 percent, and is still 9.7 percent short of target. Year to date the portfolio is 6.1 percent ahead of target, and Aqua HK (−6.2 percent) and Dim Sum Library (−8.9 percent) remain the only two venues behind on the financial year line. Shiro is shown as two sites: Shiro Pacific Place booked 85 and Shiro Tai Kwun 65. Together that is the 150 measured against Shiro’s combined target of 132. Tai Kwun opened in 2026, so it has no year-on-year comparison. Below the portfolio line, outside the target set: Vesu booked 57 against 83 the week before and 68 in the same week last year, and The Canton Library, open since 8 September, booked 37 against 27. Neither is in the portfolio total or its variance.
outside_label: Outside the target set: not in the portfolio total or its variance
foot_extra: Shiro’s weekly target of 132 (YTD 4,391) covers both sites, so the two Shiro rows carry no individual target and are measured together on the “Shiro, both sites” row. Shiro’s Meta and Google accounts are shared by both sites, so Shiro ad spend is shown once on that row and never split. The Canton Library’s cost per booking leaves out its awareness campaign spend; its Google Ads account still has no verified booking conversion. Targets for Vesu and The Canton Library are not set yet.
